sources.title: How to improve tool life in turning
sources.titleEn: How to improve tool life in turning
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 車削工件夾持工程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付控制體熱量帳與兩原因辨識表。；教學移熱需求≥1200 W，1000 W 不足、1600 W 達標；材料與工作溫度界限另查。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a control-volume heat balance and two-cause diagnosis table.; At a teaching removal need≥1200 W, 1000 W fails and 1600 W passes; temperature/material limits remain separate.
related.difference: 用摩擦力矩模型檢查夾持概念，區分防滑與工件變形。
related.differenceEn: Check a clamping concept with friction torque while separating slip resistance from deformation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 穩態顯熱 Qdot=mdot cp ΔT，不含相變與旁通。；教學 mdot=0.05 kg/s、cp=4000 J/(kg·K)、ΔT=5 K。；Qdot=0.05×4000×5=1000 W。
理想可抵抗力矩 M=μNtotal r；接觸力相加但不可重複計入每爪。；教學 μ=0.20、Ntotal=300 N、r=0.020 m；外加力矩 0.60 N·m。；M=0.20×300×0.020=1.20 N·m，靜態比值為 2。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Steady sensible heat Qdot=mdot cp ΔT, excluding phase change and bypass.; Teaching mdot=0.05 kg/s, cp=4000 J/(kg·K), ΔT=5 K.; Qdot=0.05×4000×5=1000 W.

Ideal resisting torque M=μNtotal r; sum contact forces without counting each jaw twice.; Teaching μ=0.20, Ntotal=300 N, r=0.020 m and external torque 0.60 N·m.; M=0.20×300×0.020=1.20 N·m, a static ratio of two.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 金屬粉床熔融製程
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付控制體熱量帳與兩原因辨識表。；教學移熱需求≥1200 W，1000 W 不足、1600 W 達標；材料與工作溫度界限另查。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver a control-volume heat balance and two-cause diagnosis table.; At a teaching removal need≥1200 W, 1000 W fails and 1600 W passes; temperature/material limits remain separate.
related.difference: 由合成收縮率反算 CAD 補償尺寸，再確認單一縮放是否足以解釋各方向誤差。
related.differenceEn: Infer CAD compensation from synthetic shrinkage and test whether one scale explains all directions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 穩態顯熱 Qdot=mdot cp ΔT，不含相變與旁通。；教學 mdot=0.05 kg/s、cp=4000 J/(kg·K)、ΔT=5 K。；Qdot=0.05×4000×5=1000 W。
Lfinal=Lcad(1−s)，因此 Lcad=Ltarget/(1−s)。；教學目標 Ltarget=40.00 mm，線性收縮率 s=0.005。；Lcad=40/(1−0.005)=40.201005 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Steady sensible heat Qdot=mdot cp ΔT, excluding phase change and bypass.; Teaching mdot=0.05 kg/s, cp=4000 J/(kg·K), ΔT=5 K.; Qdot=0.05×4000×5=1000 W.
Lfinal=Lcad(1−s), hence Lcad=Ltarget/(1−s).; Teaching target Ltarget=40.00 mm and linear shrinkage s=0.005.; Lcad=40/(1−0.005)=40.201005 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
